name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Yuggidrasil
summary:
Both the Yu-Gi-Oh! you remember, and every Yu-Gi-Oh! you've ever imagined.

Press SELECT on the main menu and the Options screen opens, with ~35 house rules, presets and Roulette (random rules every duel). Some are borrowed from the anime and manga, some from the early Yu-Gi-Oh! video games, some from modern card-game formats, and some are brand new. Mix them freely. Every rule starts on Normal, so until you change something it's the classic game you remember, just faster: Turbo plays every duel as if you were holding B.
